chapters.label: The hat-trick
chapters.text: Old Trafford, 2012. Canada and the USA are level, two-all, in the Olympic semi-final. Canada take a corner... Christine Sinclair heads it in! Her third goal: a hat-trick!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Sinclair watches the ball in the air. She pushes away from two defenders and gets to the spot first.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: she heads it back across, to the far post, away from the keeper.

chapters.label: The right place
chapters.text: Great strikers are always in the right place. Watch where the ball will land, and get there first!
